review.summary: B1-B30 are implemented by exported command(n) dispatch, but B31 is not satisfied.

findings.problem: For an exported save call with a store whose write(value) throws Error("boom"), the catch block discards the error and save returns {ok:true}. This violates the required ok:false result with the error message and preservation of the input value.
findings.nextAction: Implement the save error path to return ok:false, include the thrown error message, and preserve the supplied input value as required by B31.
